arguments.summary: A worm utilizing the EternalBlue exploit (MS17-010) was detected propagating across the production subnet 10.0.4.0/24. Initial access traced to host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) in the Finance department, which exhibited Cobalt Strike beaconing and lateral movement via SMB.
